P05-008.device_notes: Paseq at 24:17 and 24:21 (count-only, single-witness, unsourceable intra-verse position). 24:24's recognition-pattern clause (2mp, Lord-YHWH variant, a member of the counted adonai-form class) is disclosed as mid-unit, paragraph-final rather than unit-final, since a refrain closes the unit it stands in, not necessarily the whole span, when the material after it is that same unit's own payoff (24:25-27). Samekh at 24:27 (single-witness) is both this unit's close and the parent collection's own close. Onset-seam mark, disclosed in three directions: MEASURED in this witness, MT 24:14 is followed by a PE (petuchah, OPEN section, single-witness), recorded on the verse it follows, so it stands behind this row's ONSET seam at 24:14/24:15. The interior direction carries a single-witness samekh after MT 24:24 (disclosed here) and the close direction the samekh after MT 24:27 (disclosed above), completing the three directions. A licensed text signal outranks a section mark, so the PE is weak corroboration; this onset rests on the full-form strict word-event formula at 24:15.
